why: Серия «Из Instagram в магазин». Офферное видео, исправленное по требованиям клиента: открытие с крупного плана рук без лиц, исключающее перекрытие текста, героиня строго 35-50 лет в деловом стиле, акцент на легкий перенос товаров и лидогенерацию через слово STORE.
rules: Main on-screen person: a woman aged 35-50, business owner look. No religious or national attire (no hijab). No cartoon or 3D characters. No text over faces.

problems: Rule violation: Client specified main on-screen person must be a woman aged 35-50, but video cuts between unrelated generic stock characters including a man taping boxes at the end.
B-roll feels like disconnected generic stock footage rather than demonstrating the InClick AI Co-pilot interface or actual Instagram-to-store conversion.
qa.fix: Focus on a single consistent 35-50 year old female business owner interacting with the AI Co-pilot interface and showing her actual Instagram turning into an e-commerce store.
